notes.note: Reviewed the final inline-only delta after the stable turn projection review: semantic ordered action-list markup, terminal-aware chip keys, shared ActionRow placement fallback, and reuse of the existing 44px control class. Browser session authority, stable live-tail ownership, terminal result semantics and explicit recording remain unchanged. The controlled consumer browser journey and responsive captures do not qualify production Chromium, provider or native behavior.

Rechecked the documented inline controls and results against the final semantic action strip and shared placement controls. The page/step relationship, stable full-screen canvas, compact completion, Float/Bring back and exact session admission remain the described behavior. The browser geometry assertion caught 41.6px desktop placement controls; the implementation now reuses the viewer’s existing 44px class without changing that assertion. No authority or recording behavior changed.
